delete.body: Your account will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
delete.description: Permanently remove your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone.
delete.title: Delete account

signOut.body: You will need to sign in again to access your account.

stopImpersonating.body: You will return to your admin account.

suspend.body: If your account is compromised, this blocks all sign-in. You can unsuspend it later with a link sent to your email.
suspend.description: Lock the account if it may be compromised, so nobody can sign in. Unsuspend it yourself later with a link sent to your email.
suspend.title: Suspend account

updatePassword.revokeOtherHint: Sign out of all other devices after changing your password

twoFactor.disableBody: You will only need your password to sign in after this. You can enable two-factor authentication again later.
twoFactor.enabledDescription: Two-factor authentication is on. Sign-in requires a code from your authenticator app or a backup code.
twoFactor.generateHint: Generate a new set of backup codes. Previous unused codes will stop working.
twoFactor.saveCodesHint: Save these codes in a safe place. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
twoFactor.scanHint: Use Google Authenticator, Authy, or another TOTP app. If you cannot scan the code, enter the secret manually.
twoFactor.setupHint: Confirm your password to start setup. Then scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter a code to turn two-factor authentication on.
twoFactor.title: Authenticator app

sessions.heading: Devices signed in to your account
sessions.revokeOtherBody: Other devices will be signed out. You will stay signed in on this device.
sessions.revokeSessionBody: This device will be signed out.
